title: An analytic derivation of a generating function for $k$-alternating permutations
summary: We study the inversion enumerator of permutations whose descent set is fixed to be the set of multiples of a fixed integer $k \ge 2$. For each $n$, let $\mathfrak{S}_n^{(k)}$ denote the set of permutations of $\{1,\dots,n\}$ whose descent set is exactly $\{i : k \mid i\}$, and define the polynomial $$ a_n^{(k)}(q)=\sum_{σ\in \mathfrak{S}_n^{(k)}} q^{\mathrm{inv}(σ)}. $$ We prove that the associated $q$-exponential generating function $$ F_k(t;q)=\sum_{n\ge 0}\frac{t^n}{[n]_q!}\,a_n^{(k)}(q), $$ where $[n]_q!$ denotes the $q$-factorial, admits an explicit closed form as a ratio of two…
